title: West Africa country profile evidence register
purpose: Track authoritative country-level agricultural survey sources before any values are admitted into GoOrganicAfrica calculator profiles.
publication_rules: Do not add a country to the active calculator dataset until its required commodity fields have been reviewed and validated.
Do not treat a country survey yield as a selling price or a complete farm budget.
Record commodity, production system, unit, geography, reference year, publication date, source URL, sampling uncertainty and any revision notice for every extracted value.
Use published aggregate tables unless the source explicitly authorizes the intended use of microdata.
Do not invent missing values. Leave unsupported fields for farmer entry or retain the clearly labelled Africa benchmark.
Do not change the calculator formula or the existing ten country profiles as part of this research package.

survey.title: Liberia Annual Agriculture Survey 2024
survey.publisher: Liberia Institute of Statistics and Geo-Information Services (LISGIS), with Ministry of Agriculture
survey.coverage: National and regional estimates; agricultural households

known_revision_notice.description: LISGIS published an official notice stating that selected previously published survey tables and indicator values were corrected or revised.
known_revision_notice.verification_required: Identify the affected tables and use the corrected release before extracting or publishing any affected figures.

survey.license_and_use: The LISGIS open-data licence page lists the 2024 crop cultivation, crop loss, crop production/yield, inputs, labour and livestock/poultry aggregate datasets as CC BY 4.0. Confirm the licence for each selected table or download before redistribution.
survey.extraction_status: Table 10 and selected labour-cost tables have been transcribed as provisional observations from the published report. All Liberia numeric observations remain on hold because LISGIS issued an August 2026 correction notice and the affected tables have not yet been identified.
remaining_gaps: resolve August 2026 LISGIS erratum and identify affected tables

provisional_observations_on_hold.caution: The report says only 28.3% of cassava households harvested during the survey period; yield is timing-specific and may understate annual output.
Crop type is reported as beans; do not assume this is cowpea without confirming the species.
Pepper type is not specified as Habanero or another particular variety; planted area has CV 46.44%, so treat the observation as low confidence.

provisional_labour_costs_on_hold.note: These are reported daily wage observations, not per-hectare labour budgets. Dashes in the source table are withheld values, represented as null. All values remain on hold pending LISGIS erratum reconciliation.

observation_caveats: All numeric values transcribed from the published October 2025 report are provisional and on hold pending identification of tables affected by the August 2026 LISGIS correction notice.

The report flags pepper planted area, rubber planted/harvested area, sweet-potato harvested area/production, eggplant harvested area/production and okra production as high-uncertainty indicators (CV > 33% or SE > 17.5%).
Cassava yield is timing-specific: only 28.3% of cassava households reported harvesting during the survey reference period, and the report warns that annual output may be understated.
A single national yield observation is not a low/expected/high calculator range.
Daily labour and other service-payment averages cannot be converted into per-hectare budgets without activity duration, worker counts and farm-system assumptions.

survey.title: Sierra Leone Annual Agricultural Survey 2024
survey.publisher: Statistics Sierra Leone and Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security, with FAO technical support
survey.coverage: National coverage except Western Urban district
quality_notes: The metadata reports sampling-error estimates for selected indicators.
The public-use dataset version was updated to reflect changes in input-use and input-detail rosters after the post-harvest visit.
The metadata states that a confidentiality declaration/access conditions apply to data files; review these conditions before any microdata use.
survey.extraction_status: Published Table 2.5 extracted into this evidence register as national point observations. These are not low/expected/high calculator ranges and are not yet admitted to calculator country_data.
remaining_gaps: current farm-gate and market selling prices by location
crop-specific low/expected/high yield ranges or a defensible method to derive them
livestock purchase, feed, veterinary and mortality cost benchmarks
confirmation of the chilli pepper variety and broad-bean taxonomy before mapping to existing calculator commodities
survey.table_reference: Table 2.5, planted area, harvested area, production and yield of crops cultivated by agricultural households, report page 24.
observation_caveats: These are national survey point estimates for the 2024 reference year, not low/expected/high production ranges.
The report covers national agricultural households; the country report notes coverage and sampling design details in its methodology and annex.
Do not treat crop production statistics as farm-gate prices or production-cost observations.
Check the report's detailed methodology and any indicator-specific sampling-error notes before using an observation as a forecast input.

next_steps: For Liberia, resolve the August 2026 LISGIS erratum against Table 10, Table 35 and Table 38 before releasing any transcribed observations from hold.
Do not convert the Sierra Leone national point yields directly into low/expected/high calculator ranges; first obtain multi-year and/or regional evidence.
For Sierra Leone, cross-check the extracted national point observations with FAOSTAT and any available indicator-specific sampling errors before considering calculator use.
Resolve the LISGIS August 2026 correction notice against the Liberia 2024 survey tables.
Extract aggregate crop production, harvested area and yield observations for overlapping calculator commodities.
Extract input-use and labour evidence separately; do not convert adoption rates into monetary costs.
Extract Sierra Leone aggregate survey tables and retain published sampling-error indicators.
Cross-check national observations against FAOSTAT country crop-production, area and yield series.
Research current market prices, input prices and regional cost sources independently for each country.
Prepare country profiles only after source, unit, date, geographic coverage and uncertainty checks are complete.
